_about: Supabase auth email templates. Each entry: the HTML file here, the template's name in the dashboard (Authentication → Emails), its subject line, and whether the Builder's hosted pilot sends it today. Subjects are stored separately from the HTML in Supabase, so they live here.

templates.subject: You are invited to the JZP Font Builder
templates.when: An admin invites a tester (Authentication → Users → Invite user).

templates.subject: Your JZP Font Builder sign-in link
templates.when: A tester asks for a sign-in link on the hosted Builder, or the admin signs in from the local Review screen.

templates.subject: Confirm your email address
templates.when: Someone signs up. Sign-ups are turned off for the pilot.

templates.subject: Confirm your new email address
templates.when: A user changes their address. The Builder has no screen for this.

templates.subject: Reset your JZP Font Builder password
templates.when: A password reset is requested. The pilot signs in by email link, without passwords.

templates.subject: Your JZP Font Builder confirmation code
templates.when: A signed-in user must confirm a sensitive action. The Builder does not ask for this.
